entries.title: A task with parts no longer reads finished while its parts are still to come
entries.body: When you approve a plan, the task above it now waits for your first mate to file the parts the plan named instead of reading finished in that moment. A part filed under a task that had closed by itself when its earlier parts finished opens it again, and such tasks that read finished while parts under them were still open open again. A task that closed for its own reasons, such as a merge or your choice, keeps its close.
entries.noPicture: Tasks look the same; the change is which tasks read open.
